claim: The AWS Backup document history dates the logically air-gapped vault to August 7, 2024, after a preview that ended June 27, 2024: it was introduced as a secondary type of vault for storing copies of backups, with enhanced security features and vault access sharing through AWS RAM. A later entry of November 17, 2025 adds primary backups: logically air-gapped vaults are now supported as a primary backup target, and previously they could only store copies of existing backups.

evidence.quote:
| AWS Backup now offers a new type of secure vault | AWS Backup has introduced a secondary type of vault for storing copies of backups. Logically air-gapped vaults offer enhanced security features as well as the ability to share vault access with accounts through AWS RAM.
For more information, see [Logically air-gapped vault](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/logicallyairgappedvault.html). | August 7, 2024 |
| Logically air-gapped vault preview closure | [Logically air-gapped vault](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/logicallyairgappedvault.html) preview has ended. | June 27, 2024 |

| Primary backups to logically air-gapped vaults | Logically air-gapped vaults are now supported as a primary backup target. This enhancement allows customers to leverage the security and recovery benefits of logically air-gapped vaults while maintaining only a single backup copy, reducing storage and operational costs. Previously, logically air-gapped vaults could only store copies of existing backups.
For more information, see [Primary backups to logically air-gapped vaults](lag-vault-primary-backup.md). | November 17, 2025 |
